verdict.rationale: Penpot documents automation surfaces: an MCP server, a plugin API, webhooks and access tokens. Nothing in the evidence shows versioning, review, or rollback of those automations. The only restore-like feature, restoring a deleted main component from a copy, concerns design components rather than automations, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
